# ezghcloud_warehouse_user (Resource)

A user of a warehouse. Its password is generated and kept in a Secret in the warehouse's project; Terraform state never holds it. Changes apply without a restart. Destroying it deletes the user and its Secret. The user app comes with the warehouse: import it to manage it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A user that reads and writes one database. Its password is in the Secret secret_id names.
resource "ezghcloud_warehouse_user" "example" {
  project_id       = ezghcloud_project.example.id
  warehouse_id     = ezghcloud_warehouse.example.id
  name             = "loader"
  preset           = "custom"
  grants           = [{ database = "events", table = "*", privileges = ["SELECT", "INSERT"] }]
  settings_profile = "heavy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Username: a lowercase letter, then up to 31 lowercase letters, digits and _. default and names starting ezgh_ are reserved. Changing it replaces the user (a new password in a new Secret).
- `project_id` (String) Project of the warehouse. Changing it replaces the user.
- `warehouse_id` (String) Warehouse (whs_) it belongs to. Changing it replaces the user.

### Optional

- `grants` (Attributes List) With preset custom: grants on databases and tables. Changes in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))
- `preset` (String) admin (everything in every database, every connection, other users' queries), readWrite (select, insert, alter and table DDL in every database), readOnly (select and show) or custom (grants). The API's default when left out at create; removing it later keeps the current preset. Changes in place.
- `settings_profile` (String) default, heavy or light: per-query memory and time limits. default when left out at create. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `failure_code` (String) Why the user's last operation failed, as a code; null when it didn't.
- `failure_message` (String) Why the user's last operation failed; null when it didn't.
- `id` (String) warehouse_id/name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `secret_id` (String) The Secret (sec_) holding the user's username and password and how to connect: host, httpsPort, nativePort, the plaintext ports, url and database.
- `status` (String) What the user is doing: creating, available, modifying, rotating, deleting or failed.

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Required:

- `database` (String) A database's name.
- `privileges` (List of String) From SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, CREATE, DROP, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE and SHOW.
- `table` (String) A table's name, or * for every table in the database.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_warehouse_user.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/WAREHOUSE_ID/NAME'
```
